title: A meeting planner across time zones
description:
Find a meeting time that suits people in different time zones.

```
Ada (London, 09:00-17:30), Bob (New York, 09:00-17:00), Cy (Tokyo, 10:00-19:00)
on 2026-11-24 the only shared hour is: none
Ada and Bob: 14:00-17:30 London time (09:00-12:30 New York)
```
hints: `new DateTimeOffset(local, zone.GetUtcOffset(local))` turns a local time into a moment, and `.ToUniversalTime()` gives UTC (lesson 8.04).
Two ranges overlap from the later start to the earlier end, when the start is before the end.
requirements: People have a time zone id and working hours as `TimeOnly` values.
Convert each person's working hours on a date to UTC `DateTimeOffset` ranges, intersect them, and show the result in each person's local time.
Pass a `TimeProvider` in so "today" can be fixed in tests.
stretch: Search the next 7 days and list every shared slot of at least 30 minutes.
